name: Mathew Deeb
title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
tagline: 10+ years building payments, observability, and developer tooling at scale.
intro: Hey — I'm Mathew. Walk around town to see where I've worked, what I've shipped, and what I do outside of work.
summary: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit Mailchimp with 10+ years of experience building end-to-end product features across payments infrastructure, observability, and developer tooling. Georgia Tech CS grad with deep full-stack experience spanning TypeScript, Python, React, Node, and cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS). Passionate about building powerful developer tools and shipping fast with high ownership.

Taiwan e-invoicing compliance system with full Slack observability
AI adoption: semi-autonomous E2E testing workflows and team code review agent
ETL microservices (Python) with legacy bank APIs, S3 staging, webhooks
Growth experimentation scoping — 20% experiment success rate
Mentored 3 engineers + 1 intern; championed microservice deployment tooling org-wide
Greenfield app design and architecture end-to-end on IBM-contracted projects
CI/CD on IBM Hybrid Cloud — replaced manual VM deploys with containerized delivery
Full-stack event dashboards (Vue, Node, Express) for hundreds of IBM events
Established Git workflows, PR reviews, and code quality standards
Cloud infrastructure apps for enterprise resource and usage analytics
In-house React component library adopted across the engineering team
CI/CD across dev, staging, and production for multiple applications

about.title: About
about.bio: I'm Mathew Deeb, a senior full-stack engineer based in Atlanta. I ship high-impact systems with strong ownership — from payments and observability at Mailchimp to greenfield apps and CI/CD for enterprise clients. Georgia Tech CS (People & UX concentration). Always building: whether it's reconciliation pipelines, AI dev tools, or an indie game in Godot.
